subject: FlightWindow briefing: sponsor pre-brief + exec demo time options
body:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@flightwindow.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: FlightWindow briefing: sponsor pre-brief + exec demo time options

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week — excited to align on a short technical walkthrough of what Redwood Inference would look like for FlightWindow. To make the most of exec time, two quick asks:

- Can we get a 15–20 minute sponsor pre-brief with your tech sponsor (CTO / Head of Platform) the day before the demo? We use that to surface the deployment model, data flow, and any compliance questions so the demo can focus on decision criteria.
- For the 60-minute demo itself, would the CTO be available for the first 30 minutes (exec-level overview + Qs) and the engineering team stay for the remaining detailed runthrough?

Proposed demo windows (all local times):
- Tue Nov 3 — 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT (works well for our east coast engineering)
- Tue Nov 9 — 2:00 PM ET / 11:00 AM PT (backup)
If neither works we can do a short window the following week.

I attached a draft agenda and a short SLA/cost summary for context. If the CTO is constrained, happy to proceed with VP-level sponsor coverage; we just like to know up front so we tailor the first 10–15 minutes.

Next steps: please confirm preferred demo date, whether the CTO can join the first 30 minutes or if the VP will cover, and an attendee list (names + titles).

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Attachment: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: SLA-overview.pdf (PDF)

-----Original Message-----
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@flightwindow.co>
Sent: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0500
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@flightwindow.co>
Subject: Re: FlightWindow briefing: sponsor pre-brief + exec demo time options

Hi Ava,

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. Quick update on availability: our CTO (Lina) is traveling on Nov 3 for a customer visit and will be in transit for most of the day, so she likely can't make the 11:00 AM ET slot. She could potentially join virtually for the first 20–30 minutes if the timing is aligned with her travel window, but I don't want to promise that yet.

Two alternatives:
- Tue Nov 3 at 8:00 AM PT could work if Lina can dial in for the first 30 minutes (she's ok with early starts).
- Tue Nov 9 is preferable for the full in-person slot for Lina.

If Lina can't commit, Raj (VP, Product) will cover the exec portion. I think having either Lina for a partial join or Raj for the full exec slot will be fine — the key is we get an aligned sponsor on the call.

Headcount: expect 3–4 from our side (Lina/Raj + 1–2 engineering leads).

Can you confirm whether you can do a 15–20 minute pre-brief on Nov 2 or Nov 3 AM PT? If so send a calendar invite and we will confirm attendees.

Best,
Samira
Director, Platform Strategy
FlightWindow Solutions
samira.k@flightwindow.co

On Sun, Nov 1, 2026 at 3:22 PM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> (See message above)

-----Original Message-----
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@flightwindow.co>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FlightWindow briefing: sponsor pre-brief + exec demo time options

Folks —

Quick internal note after Samira's reply: Lina may only join briefly. Can we do the following?

- Karthik: can you own the 15–20 minute sponsor pre-brief (to run through infra, expected telemetry, and compliance questions)? Samira asked for Nov 2 or Nov 3 morning PT — I think Nov 2 (10:00 AM ET / 7:00 AM PT) would give us time to adjust before the demo if needed.
- Marissa: can you prepare one slide that summarizes latency / cost tradeoffs and the proposed deployment (hosted vs dedicated) so we can share in the pre-brief and pin it to slide 1 of the demo?

If Lina confirms she can do 8:00 AM PT on Nov 3 for the first 30 minutes, let's lock Nov 3 11:00 AM ET as the demo slot and I will send the invite. If not, we move to Nov 9 and keep the pre-brief as planned.

Also note the attached SLA doc — the customer raised a questions on data retention and audit logs last quarter; please have answers ready.

Thanks —
Ava

-----Inline replies follow-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FlightWindow briefing: sponsor pre-brief + exec demo time options

Ava/Marissa —

I can run the sponsor pre-brief. Nov 2 at 10:00 AM ET (7:00 AM PT) works for me — I'll aim to keep it tight at 20 minutes:

Agenda for pre-brief (20 min):
- 5m: quick intro + deployment recommendation
- 8m: infra/telemetry & security controls (audit logs, retention)
- 5m: integration risks + next steps
- 2m: confirm demo goals and attendee list

Marissa — if you can drop the cost/latency slide into the shared folder by EOD Nov 1 I will include that in the pre-brief deck.

I will also prepare a 1‑page note for Lina/Raj summarizing what we hope to cover in the exec portion (so Lina can decide whether to join for the first 20–30 minutes).

-Karthik

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 10:05 AM Samira Khan <samira.k@flightwindow.co> wrote:
> Hi Ava / team,
>
> Confirming: Nov 3 at 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT works — Lina will try to join for the first ~30 minutes and Raj will be on for the full slot. Expect 4 attendees from FlightWindow (Lina, Raj, and two engineering leads).
>
> Please send an updated invite with the pre-brief (Nov 2) and the demo (Nov 3) calendar items; add a video dial-in and the DocuSign NDA link if you can. Also please include the SLA doc and the brief agenda.
>
> Cheers,
> Samira
